device.description: 10-bit 20 MSPS +3 V pipelined ADC with internal reference and parallel CMOS outputs
device.note: ads900.pdf (SBAS058A) p.2-3 electrical characteristics (rising-edge convert clock, 5-clock latency, straight offset binary, 3-state enable 40 ns / disable 10 ns max, +VS 2.7-3.7 V), p.4 pin configuration and descriptions, timing diagram (t2 new data delay 12 ns max), p.9 digital output data, OE, coding Table I, p.11 digital outputs (LVDD), p.12 power-down mode (Pwrdn high = power down, outputs 3-state)

pages: p.2-3 (specifications), p.4 (pins, timing), p.9 (output data, OE, Table I), p.11 (digital outputs, LVDD), p.12 (power-down)
notModeled: analog input and internal reference (ladder bypass LpBy/LnBy, CM and 1VREF outputs); the result is always the 0 V differential (bipolar zero) code 200h, straight offset binary (single-ended use: IN at 1.5 V gives the same code)
pipeline latency of 5 clock cycles (the code is constant); data invalid for 5 clocks after leaving power-down
clock period / duty-cycle limits (50 ns to 100 us) and aperture delay

two supplies: +VS 2.7-3.7 V (analog core and CLK/OE/Pwrdn inputs) and LVDD (output drivers); the datasheet gives no LVDD range (specified at LVDD = +3 V), so vcc is the +VS range and +VS is listed under analog so LVDD is the digital supply
the clock input is described as accepting +5 V or +3 V CMOS levels (p.11) but the absolute maximum logic input is +VS + 0.3 V; inputMax is not set
3-state enable time (40 ns max) differs from the disable time (10 ns); tFloat uses the disable time; internal 50 kOhm pull-downs on OE and Pwrdn (OE floating = enabled)
pin 24 is the complementary input (IN with an overbar in the datasheet); both inputs are named IN
